item.title: [IGNITE-17542] Test CacheLateAffinityAssignmentTest.testAffinitySimpleNoCacheOnCoordinator2 became flaky after IGNITE-17507
item.description:
The test CacheLateAffinityAssignmentTest.testAffinitySimpleNoCacheOnCoordinator2 became flay due to IGNITE-17507.
The root cause of the issue that CacheAffinityChangeMessage mutates the message outside the disco-notifier thread, and this fact may lead to the following exception:
